description: This file contains tests for cron stagger helper functions, including detection of recurring top-of-hour cron expressions, normalization of stagger values, and resolution of effective staggering for cron schedules. It uses Vitest testing framework and imports helper functions from another module.

methods.name: describe
methods.description: Defines a test suite for cron stagger helpers.

methods.name: expect
methods.description: Asserts that a value meets certain conditions within a test.

methods.name: isRecurringTopOfHourCronExpr
methods.description: Function to detect if a cron expression recurs at the top of the hour.

methods.name: normalizeCronStaggerMs
methods.description: Function to normalize stagger values into milliseconds.

methods.name: resolveCronStaggerMs
methods.description: Function to determine the effective stagger time based on cron expression and override.
